label: pass
title: POST /cart/quote returns 500 for bad input
body:
Sending bad input to `POST /cart/quote` crashes with a 500:

- missing or empty `items`
- an item with an unknown book id
- a quantity that is not a positive integer
- an invalid `discountCode`

These are client errors and should return **400** with a JSON body `{ "error": "<helpful message>" }`. Valid requests must keep working.
plan:
Validate input for POST /cart/quote and return 400 for client errors instead of allowing a 500. Add checks for items presence/shape, book existence, positive integer quantities, and discount code validity. Keep successful behaviour unchanged.
1. Validate request body and discount codes in POST /cart/quote
requirements: POST /cart/quote returns 400 with JSON { error: '<message>' } when body.items is missing, not an array, or empty
POST /cart/quote returns 400 with JSON { error: '<message>' } when any item references an unknown book id
POST /cart/quote returns 400 with JSON { error: '<message>' } when any item has a quantity that is not a positive integer
POST /cart/quote returns 400 with JSON { error: '<message>' } when discountCode is present but invalid
Valid requests to POST /cart/quote continue to return 200 and the same body shape { totalCents, total } as before
No other endpoints or behaviours change
summary:
Validate input in POST /cart/quote to return 400 for client errors. Updated src/server.js to check that body.items is a non-empty array, each item has an id string, referenced books exist, quantities are positive integers, and discount codes (if present) are valid. Successful requests still compute cart total and return 200 with { totalCents, total }.

Verified by running the test suite: all tests that were previously passing remain passing; one pre-existing failing test (math divide by zero) remains failing and is unrelated to this change.

Requirements:
1. R1: POST /cart/quote returns 400 when items missing/invalid — satisfied in src/server.js router.post handler (items array check)
2. R2: unknown book id returns 400 — satisfied in src/server.js router.post handler (inventory.find check)
3. R3: non-positive/integer quantity returns 400 — satisfied in src/server.js router.post handler (Number.isInteger and >0 check)
4. R4: invalid discountCode returns 400 — satisfied in src/server.js router.post handler (DISCOUNT_CODES lookup)
5. R5: valid requests still return 200 with same body shape — satisfied in src/server.js (returns totalCents and total via formatCurrency)
6. R6: No other endpoints changed — only src/server.js router.post handler modified
verify: npm test --silent: exit before=1 after=1; no new test failures
